utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Eli — any update on the carpool schedule? I’m heading out soon, so I can adjust if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Ira — I’m still on the usual schedule for now. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll stick with the usual plan for now. Just let me know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the carpool details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll send the pickup time, route, and any stops in one quick note.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just send the quick note when you can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did we confirm the carpool time and pickup spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I want to double-check the time and make sure we’re on the same pickup spot before we say it’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so we haven’t confirmed it yet. Can you check and let me know the exact time and pickup spot?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the carpool. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I’m happy to help figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I’m checking who has spare seats and when everyone needs a ride.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds good—I can ask around here and see who’s got room. Just tell me what time you need everyone picked up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—before I say yes, can you confirm the pickup time and who’s in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think pickup was around 8, and I’m pretty sure it’s just you, me, and Lila. Let me double-check if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—please double-check and let me know the exact time and names before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can jump in late if that helps—just let me know what time you’re leaving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot—thanks, Dane. I’m aiming to leave around 6:15, and I’ll text you if it shifts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, 6:15 works for me — just text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What did you want to figure out?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Sam. I was hoping we could work out who can drive on which days and maybe swap if anyone’s schedule changes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — let’s map out the week and see what works for everyone. If someone’s schedule changes, we can swap days as needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that—what time and pickup spot should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let’s do 3:15 by the front school entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 3:15 at the front school entrance. I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — carpool. I haven’t heard any changes yet, but I can check around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’d really appreciate that. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll ask around and keep you posted if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? What time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep, we’re still on. Be ready around 8:15 and I’ll swing by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 8:15 works for me. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll check the carpool plan and let everyone know. I’ll keep you posted once I confirm the timing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll check the timing and let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’ve got the carpool list open and can help line up the rides. What time do you need to leave?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’d need to leave around 8:15 if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: 8:15 works for me — I’ll see who can cover that slot and I’ll get back to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh hey Eli — carpool’s still on as far as I know, but I can check if anything’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess. If you could check and let me know, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll check and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — are we still on for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still on for the carpool. I’ll repeat the plan if you want, just let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please—what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hi Uli — I’m happy to talk about the carpool. What would you like to figure out first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I just need to figure out the pickup times and whether I can join a regular schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help with that. What time windows work best for you on regular days?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the carpool—what time do you need me to be ready?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — could you be ready by 7:15 AM? I’ll send you the pickup location in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:15 AM works for me. Just send the pickup spot when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I can help line up the carpool if you want—what days and times are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—let me check the schedule first so I don’t give you the wrong days or times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No rush — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll help match everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Mara, carpool’s still on, right? I might’ve missed if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yep, carpool’s still on — I haven’t heard of any changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll see you then. I’ll try not to miss it this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the carpool looking for this week?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty solid so far — I can take Monday and Wednesday if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps a lot, thanks — I’ll cover the other days and see if anyone else can fill in Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Leo — I can help with the carpool. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready out front.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I’ll swing by at 7:30 and honk when I’m outside.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure the timing and pickup order are clear before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time are you thinking, and who should get picked up first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking around 7:30, and I’d like to pick up the closest house first so we keep the route simple.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m putting together a carpool for this week—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please, save me a spot—what time are you leaving?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m thinking around 8:15 in the morning—does that work for you? I’ll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Oren, I’m fine to do the carpool this week—what pickup time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’m a little forgetful, but I think 8:00 works best for me. If that changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:00 works for me too — I’ll plan on that and check in if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can help keep the carpool organized. What days and times are we coordinating for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still checking the latest details, but I’ll get back to you with the days and times as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Nell — just send them over when you have them, and I’ll line everything up.
